Sandbox_VICCS_TCG_SpawnRate_tooltip: Adjusts overall rarity of booster packs and binders spawning in the world.
Sandbox_VICCS_TCG_AllowResidential_toolt: Allows booster packs and binders to spawn in living rooms, nightstands, and wardrobes.
Sandbox_VICCS_TCG_AllowSchool: Allow Spawn in Schools & Kids Rooms
Sandbox_VICCS_TCG_AllowSchool_tooltip: Allows cards to spawn in school lockers, desks, and children bedrooms.
Sandbox_VICCS_TCG_AllowCommercial_toolti: Allows packs and binders to spawn in comic book shops, toy stores, and magazine racks.
Sandbox_VICCS_TCG_HoloChancePercent_tool: Chance (0-100%) that the rare slot in a booster pack turns into a holographic foil.
Sandbox_VICCS_TCG_PreFilledBinderChance: Chance of Abandoned Binder with Cards (%)
Sandbox_VICCS_TCG_PreFilledBinderChance_: Probability that a binder found in the world already contains cards saved by a former collector.
Sandbox_VICCS_TCG_PreFilledCardsMin_tool: Minimum number of cards that can be pre-filled inside a found binder (min 1).
Sandbox_VICCS_TCG_PreFilledCardsMax_tool: Maximum number of cards that can be pre-filled inside a found binder (max 102).
Sandbox_VICCS_TCG_ZombieBoosterDropChanc: Probability (from 0% to 100%) that a killed zombie contains booster packs in its corpse loot (0% = disabled).
Sandbox_VICCS_TCG_ZombieBoosterMin_toolt: Minimum number of booster packs that can drop on a lucky zombie corpse upon death.
Sandbox_VICCS_TCG_ZombieBoosterMax_toolt: Maximum number of booster packs that can drop on a lucky zombie corpse upon death.
